description: 1 master suite, 1 shower bathroom, open plan living-kitchen-dining, 1 storage room. Double-aspect apartment — windows on top and left facade(s). Kitchen is on an interior wall away from windows — less natural light at the cooking position. 1 master suite (en-suite bathroom, no walk-in wardrobe), 0 single bedroom(s). Single bedrooms can each function as bedroom, home office, hobby room or guest room. Kitchen: L-shaped, no island. Cook partially faces the living area depending on position at counter. No wall separates kitchen from dining and living — fully open plan. Living area arrangement: linear kitchen-dining-living. Dining table visible, approximately 4 seats. Bathroom config: 1 shower-only bathroom(s). Single bathroom — sequential morning routine. Master suite close to entry and kitchen — convenient morning access, less acoustic separation from activity. Storage room in entry or private zone, not adjacent to kitchen — suitable for coats, shoes, bikes, laundry or utility storage, not as kitchen pantry. Entry area has space for coat and shoe storage. From entry: kitchen is immediate, living area is short corridor. No door between entry and living/kitchen — relevant where local regulations require separation. Suits: singles or couples.
not_suitable_for: jurisdictions requiring door separation between entry and kitchen
